_readme: Single source of truth for every resume, cover letter and portfolio variant. The pipeline may select, reorder and rephrase facts from here but must never add a claim that is not here. status: confirmed = you verified it; stated = appears in your own documents, not yet re-confirmed; conflict = documents disagree, see open_conflicts. Do not put phone numbers or other private data in this file (the repo is on GitHub).

timeline.note: Promoted Nov 2020, four months after becoming Principal. About 4.6 years.
Joined as individual contributor; worked on DataDirect HDP and ARC Configuration Manager.
IIT Kanpur incubated, funded by Hyderabad Angels.
IIT Kanpur incubated, funded by SIDBI.
Innovation projects for the dev-tools group; Hercules Award. This is what led to the MDes in 2011. See wipro_framing.

counting_rules.ux_experience_years: Count from CitiTalk (2013-01). Do not count Wipro engineering or the MDes. As of Nov 2026 this is 13 years 10 months: say '13+ years', and '14 years' from Jan 2027. Never round up.
counting_rules.total_experience_years: Decision by Mayukh, 2026-11-05: 17+ years of professional experience including Wipro. '14+ years of experience' may be used on résumés when a JD asks for it. Do not write '14+ years in UX' or '14+ years of UX' before Jan 2027.
counting_rules.design_leadership_years: Progress Manager (Nov 2020 to Jun 2025, about 4.6 yrs) plus Healers at Home (2 yrs, team of 6) is about 6.6 years. '5+ years of design leadership' is supported. If a JD asks for people management specifically, state the Progress figure (about 4.5 yrs) and the Healers team separately.
counting_rules.title_rule: Progress is always shown as three roles (Senior, Principal, Manager), never as one Manager role from 2018.

claims.text: Latest-Terraform adoption across HCP workspaces rose from 33% to 80%+ within two months of the bulk version update release, increasing RUM and business revenue.
Designed and prototyped the agentic upgrade flow using Claude Code and the Helios Design System MCP server.
Foundational research with technical stakeholders at Tier-1 financial institutions (JPMC, DBS Bank).
Redesigned HashiCorp Consul UI on the Helios design system, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA.
Defined the North Star interaction model for a Terraform infrastructure visualization VS Code extension.
OECC (zero-to-one) managing IT security and operations across cloud and on-premise: 80% increase in adoption of the latest OpenEdge version.

Customer quote on the OECC case study, approved for publishing by Mayukh on 2026-11-05: "OECC PAS UI is very intuitive and is helping us manage 1000s of our customers servers easily and efficiently." Benny Scott, Software Architect, QAD. Use only as this attributed quote; 1000s is the customer's own figure, not a measured product metric.

Integrated analytics tools (Pendo/CUJ metrics); used data analysis to identify and redesign a critical user-flow bottleneck in the ARC Configuration Manager, improving key conversion rates. No conversion figure is on record, so do not state one.
Hosted webinars via the Customer Validation Portal and User Group (PUG) conferences, establishing continuous feedback loops that fed product roadmap improvements and design validation.
OpenEdge platform CSAT improved by 25%. OECC and the Memory Profiler are parts of that platform. Always attribute to the platform, never to one project.
AI-enabled Memory Profiler cut memory-related support calls and forum inquiries by 50%.
WCAG 2.2 AA design system with Dark, Light and Classic themes accelerated delivery by 30%.
Connected Figma style variables to Kendo ThemeBuilder; generated stylesheets stored in GitHub for developers.
Grew the Progress ADP UX team from 2 to 7 across the US, Bulgaria and India, including integrating designers from the Ipswitch and Kemp acquisitions.
UX maturity survey moved Progress ADP teams from 'Interested' to 'Committed' (2019 to 2024).
UX-built personas are included in every JIRA story for Progress ADP; Design Thinking courses became mandatory for ADP engineers.
A/B-tested landing pages lifted lead conversion.
Led a team of six designers and front-end developers and architected the Healer Management System UX.
Led an 11-person automation team onsite in Ohio; built a tool that cut manual test scripting by 90%; won the Hercules Award.
Patent awarded for medical device design; Samsung App Contest winner 2012.
50+ customer interviews across 25 customers, including financial institutions (DSK Bank, AmBank Group, Associated Bank).
250K businesses impacted across my work at Progress (OpenEdge, about 100K+ businesses) and HashiCorp. Always say 'across Progress and HashiCorp'; never attach 250K to a single employer.
CitiTalk reached 31,000+ users and 1.6M+ messages in 9 weeks, and 50,000+ installs within 6 months.
claims.metric: 31,000+ users in 9 weeks; 50,000+ installs in 6 months
claims.note: 1.6M+ messages comes from the DevRev resume. 5,000+ DAU was reached over about 6 months (you, Nov 2026).

claims.text: On the Memory Profiler I worked as a manager who also shipped: Manager, UX and hands-on lead designer.

At Wipro, built an automatic test-script generation tool used by client Cardinal Health (cut manual scripting by 90%) and received the Hercules Award; this led to design education at IIT Kanpur in 2011.
claims.note: Only this one project is recorded. Say 'innovation projects' (plural) only after more specifics are added.

claims.text: CitiTalk's customer acquisition cost was around ₹15.
The Memory Profiler is a data-dense developer tool: live memory graphs, AI-enabled snapshot comparison, and Tags, Requests and Objects explorers for tracing slow memory leaks.
Led design strategy for HashiCorp's move from Datadog to IBM Instana and defined shared monitoring and dashboard standards.
Designed OpenTelemetry configuration in OECC so telemetry exports to New Relic, Datadog and other platforms.
Developed four key OpenEdge user personas, based on customer interviews, that are now used across the company.
Ran weekly design reviews, weekly 1:1s, team meetings and Fun Friday for a distributed team; every designer owned a product area and ran their own user studies.
Redesigned the information architecture of PAS administration in OECC (previously 5-6 levels deep) by splitting it by persona: DevOps Engineer and ABL Developer.
As co-founder of CitiTalk, recruited the designers, engineers and interns.
At Healers at Home, worked directly with the founder, set up the product design function single-handedly and built the team.
The Memory Profiler involved extensive data visualization.
Setting up the Progress design system required visual design skills (visual language, themes).
At Healers at Home, built the company website from scratch and designed marketing material: posters, brochures, Facebook and Instagram ads, YouTube ads.
At Progress, managed Principal and senior designers and senior researchers.
At Progress, recruited 2 senior and one junior UX designers.
At Healers at Home, did website design, brochures, Facebook ads and SEO landing pages, and worked closely with a marketing/SEO/SEM agency.
At CitiTalk, designed marketing material: posters, brochures, Facebook and Instagram ads, YouTube ads.
claims.source: user, 2026-11-05 (list applied to both startups; confirm)

claims.text: Won the Samsung game design contest in 2012. (Existing awards claim says 'Samsung App Contest winner 2012'; wording to be confirmed.)

17+ years of professional experience, counting Wipro (designing and building developer tools) and design roles from 2013. Résumés may say '14+ years of experience'. Keep the word UX out of that figure: the UX-only figure stays '13+ years'.
At Wipro, designed developer tools, under the real title Senior Software Engineer.
Promoted from Principal UX Designer to Manager, User Experience, and kept doing hands-on design work.
Found the bottleneck in the ARC (Autonomous REST Connector) UI through analytics; the UI was changed and ARC business improved a lot afterwards. No figure is on record, so do not state one.
OECC and Progress HDP had many identity and access management features; spent a lot of time designing IAM and RBAC.
OECC and the Memory Profiler enabled self-service, reducing support ticket volume. The 50% figure belongs to the Memory Profiler only; no figure is on record for OECC.
Reported to the Vice President of Product Management; regularly communicated and presented to Directors and senior engineering Fellows.
OECC and the Memory Profiler helped OpenEdge customers upgrade to the latest version, increasing Progress revenue. No revenue figure is on record, so do not state one.
Hosted webinars in Progress User Groups and implemented Pendo analytics in OpenEdge products.

open_conflicts.issue: The existing resume PDFs still show Progress as one Manager role from 2018, 100,000 businesses, and CSAT credited to OECC.
open_conflicts.need: Nothing from you; the Phase 1 builder will regenerate them from this file.

wipro_framing.allowed: Use case by case when a JD values engineering depth or dev-tools experience: 'Before design school I spent four years as a software engineer at Wipro, where I built an automatic test-script generation tool used by client Cardinal Health (90% less manual scripting, Hercules Award); that led me to the MDes at IIT Kanpur.' May be listed under experience with its real title (Senior Software Engineer).
wipro_framing.not_allowed: Do not give it a designer job title, and do not add Wipro years into a UX or design years figure without labeling it. When a JD's years threshold is met only by counting Wipro, say '13+ years in UX, plus 4 years in engineering building developer tools', and let the pipeline flag the gap.
wipro_framing.todo: Optional: add more dev-tools innovation projects. Until then, describe one project, not several.

resolved_conflicts.decision: 250K total across Progress and HashiCorp work.
Both correct: 31,000+ users in 9 weeks, 50,000+ installs in 6 months.
+25% CSAT is for the whole OpenEdge platform; OECC and Memory Profiler are parts of it.
Manager who also shipped (hands-on lead designer).
Automatic test-script generation tool used by client Cardinal Health. One project recorded.

rules.why: +25% CSAT belongs to the whole OpenEdge platform, not to OECC alone.
250K must always be stated as 'across Progress and HashiCorp'.
On the Memory Profiler the role was Manager who also shipped; do not call it a Principal role.
Progress must not show one 2018-2025 Manager range; use NOV 2020 - JUNE 2025 plus the earlier roles.
UX experience is 13+ years (Jan 2013 start). Never round up.
Progress must not be shown as one 7-year Manager role; it is three roles.
